docs.description: One item in a vertical section nav rail — settings and admin sub-navigation. 5 variants: state (default, hover, focus, selected, disabled); selected maps to aria-current=page and uses tint + indicator, not colour alone. Props: label (text), icon (instance swap). Part of the Section Nav pattern; for primary app navigation use Nav Item inside Sidebar.

rules.reason: One item of a section nav rail (settings and admin sub-navigation): a destination, a link where it has an `href` and a button otherwise, the current one selected (`aria-current="page"`, its description says). MUI's ButtonBase on the web, for its keyboard focus (focus-visible) and its link or button element, as Nav Item's; its icon and label drawn with the shared layer helpers. Bespoke in Flutter, drawn and pressable.
